an5.221:1.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave ādīnavā dīghacārikaṃ anavatthacārikaṃ anuyuttassa viharato.
an5.221:1.3: Assutaṃ na suṇāti, sutaṃ na pariyodapeti, suten' ekaccena avisārado hoti, gāḷhaṃ rogātaṅkaṃ phusati, na ca mittavā hoti.
an5.221:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā dīghacārikaṃ anavatthacārikaṃ anuyuttassa viharato. 3.
an5.221:2.3: Assutaṃ suṇāti, sutaṃ pariyodapeti, suten' ekaccena visārado hoti, na gāḷhaṃ rogātaṅkaṃ phusati, mittavā ca hoti.
an5.221:2.4: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā samavatthacāre
